'''Herfølge Boldklub''' is a Danish [[Football (soccer)|football]] club founded in 1921. It is based in [[Herfølge]], a southern suburb of [[Køge]] in the eastern part of [[Zealand]]. In 2009, the club shared its licence, and merged its professional football with [[Køge BK]] to form [[HB Køge]]."}}
